defaultTitle.en: Four Seasons Resort and Residences Whistler

defaultDescription.zh-CN: 隐于黑梳山上村静谧松林间，全套房与宽敞客房均配壁炉与阳台，并在黑梳山缆车站旁设专属Ski Concierge雪具厅，步行约5分钟或乘专车即上雪道。
defaultDescription.en: Tucked into peaceful Blackcomb Upper Village pines with fireplace guestrooms and a private Ski Concierge cabin beside the Blackcomb Gondola, 5 minutes on foot or by house shuttle.
defaultDescription.zh-Hant: 隱於黑梳山上村靜謐松林間，全套房與寬敞客房均配壁爐與陽臺，並在黑梳山纜車站旁設專屬Ski Concierge雪具廳，步行約5分鐘或乘專車即上雪道。
